Hi all —

Quick finance update after tracing with Treasury and our bank:

1) Collection details
- Receiving entity: Redwood Europe SA (EUR collection)
- IBAN: GB29REDB00012345678901
- BIC: REDWGB2LXXX
- Our platform posts receipts to the EUR nostro account and then books to the customer ledger on value date.

2) The specific payment
- Payer reference: AURE-20280510
- Our bank confirmation shows an inbound credit of EUR 84,110.25 on 2028-05-11 (value date 2028-05-10) with an intermediary deduction of EUR 262.25. The gross instructed amount was EUR 84,372.50.
- Attached: payment_trace_MT103_redwood.pdf (SWIFT copy). This document shows the intermediary BIC as INTRBEXX (intermediary bank).

3) Nostro/Vostro cutover and FX window notes (important):
- Our bank's nostro cutover (end-of-day processing for EUR corridors) is 17:00 CET. If an intermediary re-routed processing after that cutover, it can change the value date and cause an FX rebooking in certain correspondent chains.
- For EU domestic EUR wires this is rare, but if the originating bank sent it via a USD/GBP hop, an intermediary rate could have been applied on their side.

4) Recovery options we can pursue
- Option A (fast): Redwood issues a one-time credit for EUR 262.25 to clear your cash application. We will then pursue recovery from the intermediary bank. This is often fastest for the customer's AP team.
- Option B (trace-first): Aurelia asks your bank to open an MT103/MT199 investigation with the intermediary (reference the MT103 we provided) and request reimbursement. This can take 2–6 weeks. If successful, Redwood would refund the recovered amount to Aurelia.

5) VAT considerations
- Issuing a credit note for the net shortfall is fine from a VAT perspective as long as the credit references the original invoice and the VAT line remains visible. If Aurelia prefers to chase the intermediary and recover cash directly, maintain the original invoice for VAT reporting — we can issue a zero-value credit note reflecting only the recovered fee later if needed. Our tax team recommends documenting the credit reason ("intermediary bank fees — reimbursement pending investigation").

Recommended next steps:
- Elena: confirm whether Aurelia wants Option A (one-time credit) to speed reconciliation, or Option B (you open a formal investigation with your bank).
- If Option B: Aurelia please ask your bank to include the intermediary BIC INTRBEXX in the investigation and provide a reference back to our MT103.
- We'll start our recovery with INTRBEXX once you confirm.
